title: 150+ Demo Clips Shipped, One Freeze Bug Killed | vitalii.no
description:
Two pilot demo clips proved the idea could work, but that left more than a hundred and fifty published features on this portfolio with no video at all. And the clips that did exist carried a hidden defect: when a voiceover ran longer than the silent footage, the fix was to freeze the last frame and hold it there -- so for the final third or so of the video, the narrator kept talking over a picture that had already stopped moving.

I generated a dedicated Remotion composition for each remaining feature -- over a hundred and fifty new .tsx files, all built from the same schema primitives (SchemaNode, Connector, Token, Caption, Badge) and the shared theme, then registered in Root.tsx. For the freeze bug, step 8 of the render pipeline was rewritten to loop the seamless silent clip with ffmpeg's -stream_loop until it covers the voiceover plus a short tail, instead of padding with a frozen frame, then trim to length.

The catalog went from 2 pilot demo clips to over 150, and every voiced render from now on loops instead of freezing -- no more videos where the picture stalls for the last third while the narration keeps going.
